score_definitions.msp: maximum softmax probability over the four known classes
score_definitions.energy_lse: positive log-sum-exp of the four known-class logits at temperature one
score_definitions.margin: largest minus second-largest known-class softmax probability

thresholds: unique NumPy quantiles of proposal scores at linspace(0,1,300), method=linear
proposal_error: unknown proposal records and incorrectly classified known proposal records are errors
proposal_pooling: pool all proposal-domain records without domain reweighting
prediction_rule: argmax of the four known-class logits in alphabetical class order; an exact tie uses the first index
comparison_arithmetic: evaluate K/A <= gamma*alpha by exact integer cross multiplication against the registered rational constants; no tolerance
member_rule: Choose the threshold with maximum accepted proposal count among thresholds satisfying K/A <= gamma*alpha and A>0. Ties use the smaller threshold. No additional proposal-coverage floor is applied.
infeasible_rule: Retain a deterministic reject-all placeholder; never shrink or refill the 12-member family.
selection_tie_break: larger procedure-specific coverage LCB, smaller gamma, lexical score alias, candidate index
